description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mullegama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo, District - Cad. Map No. 520013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Plot No. 14, Block 19) with detailed land particulars including ownership details, extent, nature of title, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registration and property ownership matters.
